description: Stable, publicly documented AI service credential prefixes.

rules.name: Anthropic API Key
rules.description: Anthropic API key using the documented sk-ant-api03 prefix.
rules.recommendation: Revoke and rotate the Anthropic API key, then load it from a secure environment variable.

rules.name: Hugging Face User Token
rules.description: Hugging Face user access token using the documented hf_ prefix.
rules.recommendation: Revoke and recreate the Hugging Face token with the minimum required role.

rules.name: Replicate API Token
rules.description: Replicate tokens are documented as 40 characters beginning with r8_.
rules.recommendation: Disable and replace the Replicate token, then store it outside source control.
